integrity_notes: The source defines function-after-Nyström; the new theorem gives a strictly specified exact distribution and sharp high-contrast laws. No third-party paper is embedded; finite checker tests supplement an analytic proof.
scientific_limitations: Only two-dimensional real symmetric positive-definite inputs with one standard Gaussian sketch column are covered.
The high-spike limit holds for fixed positive smaller eigenvalue; no claim about changing dimension or oversampling.
The direct function-Nyström comparator is evaluated with the same probe but is not presented as having matched matrix-vector cost.
The direct rank-one trace-residual mean is known in a more general form; no novelty claim is made for that identity.
Independent publication-precedence and scientific audits have not been performed.
title: Exact planar funNyström log-trace law and its two-scale spectral-spike limit
